parent_objective: audit bounded-panel measured execution result before ranking or paper claims
blocked_by: M1777 result must be audited before interpretation
supersedes: direct bounded-panel controller-family ranking after measured execution

public_gates: M1778 must use only M1777 artifacts and must not rerun rollout
M1778 must audit target counts failure rows metric completeness guardrails and role outcome distribution
M1778 must decide whether to admit localization, ranking design, scenario repair, or branch synthesis
M1778 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits completed 288-cell bounded-panel public diagnostic execution before interpretation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if execution pass criteria are not actually satisfied
stop if outcomes are too dominated for ranking
stop if metric semantics are insufficient for paper-route comparison
stop if workflow cadence requires branch synthesis
fallback_plan: route to outcome localization if outcome dominance blocks ranking
route to ranking design only if role outcomes are interpretable
route to scenario or metric repair if audit finds artifact issues

admission_evidence: M1777 reports 288 episodes, zero failures, complete metrics, and clean guardrails
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1778 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for localization, ranking design, repair, or synthesis
next_stage_criteria: ranking remains blocked unless explicitly admitted by audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1778 audits public diagnostic outcomes and does not prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: Audit must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If outcomes are dominated or weak, route to localization or scenario-quality repair, not self-ID claim weakening.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1777 can be audited as a complete bounded-panel measured execution before interpretation.
success_criteria: M1778 verifies execution pass criteria and outcome distribution
M1778 makes the next route explicit
M1778 preserves no-reset no-rollout no-training no-ranking and no-paper-claim guardrails
failure_criteria: audit ranks profiles or claims paper-level evidence

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1777 bounded-panel measured execution artifacts without reset or rollout

decision_rule: M1778 passes if it audits M1777 and chooses the next route without reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
